title: bardolier new output
description: What `bardolier new` created. cli-spec.md §6 (Projects), §10 (seeded files). Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

root.description: The configured root's name this project was created under (phase 18).

seeded.description: File names written per §10, in write order.

services.description: Services attached at creation by --services, sorted by key, each with the host port assigned to it (§5).

degraded_roots.description: Present only when a configured root could not be read while this ran (phase 27) — allocation used its last known state instead of refusing.

offline_root.description: One unreadable root and how stale bardolier's last look at it is. This block is duplicated verbatim in new/clone/service-add/port-add; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

attached_service.description: An attached service: the manifest's host port joined with the catalogue's identity. cli-spec.md §4.1, §4.2, §5. This block is duplicated verbatim in new/clone/service-add/service-remove/service-list; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

host_port.description: The debugging tap on the Mac (§5). NOT what the dev app connects to.

data_dir.description: Absolute path of this service's data directory, <project>/data/<key> (phase 19).
